title: Mutation-task bank with a free OpenRouter model through the Reticle interface
hypothesis: A free model on the same 20 tasks lands in the 30-70% acceptance zone (Sonnet: 80%), giving the harness comparisons a gradient in the regime where both Self-Harness and ModularRSI report the largest effects.

prerequisites.text: S6a wiring: run_pilot.py --tasks FILE.json IDS applies mutation_patch and removes hidden_paths (materializer mutation-workspace-v2, merged at eb3c160)
gold/noop controls on materializer v2 passed (s6a-control-gold-mut-v2, s6a-control-noop-mut-v2 at 34723a3)
owner approval: sequence approved in session 2026-09-28 ('I agree with that sequence'); permission rule added by the owner

arms.name: free-incumbent
arms.note: Same policy, toolset, backend and budgets as card 007's incumbent; only the client/model differ. Free-tier shared pool may rate-limit: 30 attempts per run allow retries with backoff.

calibration.note: The markdown card's selection: select_calibration_tasks.py --seed 7, recorded before any calibration run.

controls.note: The tasks the recorded v2 controls ran on (mut-006 is not in the calibration set).

campaign.note: free model; 40 x 30 = 1200 attempts plus room for reruns; any billed cost stops the campaign

stop_rules.repeat_rule: The markdown asks for the repeat flag to be recorded while the run continues. run_pilot.py records the flag only with --stop-on-repeats, which also stops the run, so this card runs without the guard and repeat_flags are derived from the transcripts afterwards (S6b).
manual: Evaluator leakage, evidence loss, or authority escape stops the campaign (run_card.py detects evidence loss and protocol drift; leakage and escape need trajectory review).
A symlink created by a run command is unreadable on the Windows host and ends the campaign as evidence loss (markdown card, 'Two runtime behaviours remain'); resume reruns the interrupted task.
Do not tune statements on these tasks after seeing results; they become the held-in set.

decision_rule: Pass for the card: 40 runs complete with evidence and at least 5 contrastive tasks (1/2). Otherwise report the distribution and propose the difficulty change under a new card. The evolution set is the 1/2 tasks plus 0/2 tasks whose trajectories show a fixable mechanism; tasks at 2/2 leave the set.
notes: One runner invocation per task and rollout, named c007-<task>-r<n>, with --max-total-calls 24, so --resume recognises those run directories. The markdown card's printed command instead runs one 20-task invocation per rollout (--run-name e3-cal007-sonnet-rk, --max-total-calls 480); that form records a single protocol hash over all 20 task contracts and is not what this card plans.
The controls are the recorded v2 controls (2 tasks), named so that a resume finds them complete instead of rerunning controls on the 20 tasks.
Choices the markdown leaves open, made here: 24 attempts per run and max_tokens 4096 (as positive-control Arm R and the S6a smoke), 60 s and 300 s retry backoff, a 3,600 s wall limit per invocation.
The markdown's fallback 'trusted-local only if the image is missing' is not expressible: a different backend is a different protocol, so a missing image stops the preflight and needs an amended card.
